name: zfmv_stream_constructor
description: zFMV_Stream::Constructor opens the AVI video stream, reads and clones source format data, prepares a display-mode destination BITMAPV4HEADER, allocates video buffers, begins codec decompression, derives timing fields, and initializes embedded image/surface fields.
known_limits: The success smoke patches Video-for-Windows providers and display pixel-pack globals instead of opening a real AVI file or codec. Provider-boundary behavior is accepted through owner-projection entries for AVIStreamOpenFromFileA, AVIStreamReadFormat, AVIStreamLength, AVIStreamInfoA, ICLocate, and ICSendMessage.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV stream/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463ef0 validates current-frame reset, AVIStreamOpenFromFileA(streamtypeVIDEO) error handling, format-size/read error handling, source/destination format allocation, frame-count and stream-info reads, destination BITMAPV4HEADER setup, pixel-mask copy, compressed-frame buffer sizing from dwSuggestedBufferSize, ICLocate/ICSendMessage(ICM_DECOMPRESS_BEGIN), frame timing math, embedded image fields, top-down height negation, and hasVideoTrack set.
The missing-file native smoke verifies the open failure path resets the current-frame index and leaves hasVideoTrack clear.

The provider-patched success smoke verifies the AVI/VFW call sequence and arguments, source and destination format fields, stream info and timing fields, allocated buffers, embedded image header fields, row/size math, RGB masks, top-down DIB height, and hasVideoTrack.
